heading: Tuesday, May 19, 2026
topLine: 2 model releases: Google Gemini 3.5 Flash and Google Gemini Omni Flash.

items.headline: Google launches Gemini 3.5 Flash at I/O
items.summary: Gemini 3.5 Flash is the first Gemini 3.5 model and launched generally available. Google reports 76.2% on Terminal-Bench 2.1 and says it outperforms Gemini 3.1 Pro on coding and agentic benchmarks. It became the default model in the Gemini app and Search AI Mode; Gemini 3.5 Pro was announced as coming later.

image.alt: Benchmark comparison table of Gemini 3.5 Flash against Claude and GPT models

items.headline: Google introduces Gemini Omni, starting with video generation
items.summary: Gemini Omni Flash is the first model in Google's Omni family, which aims to generate output from any combination of inputs, starting with video. It supports multi-turn conversational video editing. It rolled out to paid Google AI subscribers in the Gemini app and Flow, and to YouTube Shorts.
